body.statement: Using exact rational rank intersections over every coordinate of \(\theta_{K_6}\), determine whether \(\operatorname{Cl}_4(K_6)=\theta_{K_6}\). If equality holds, certify the complete closure transcript and reject cycle length alone as evidence of degree growth; if it fails, return a proper fixed point and use its surviving multigrading to calibrate the windmill obstruction in \(\mathrm{oeq:sharp\mbox{-}frontier}\).
body.justification: This bounded computation destroys the most tempting false growth heuristic before the asymptotic family is frozen.
body.gap: Tree-cycle papers prove sound quadratic elimination, but neither they nor the degree-bounded algorithm compute the source-defined minimum degree for this outside-HTC two-cycle graph.
body.consumer: The windmill program receives either a concrete low-degree multigrading or an immediate warning that two-cycle length cannot support its lower exponent.
